payload.title: 40 Wedding Processional Songs to Walk Down the Aisle To
payload.excerpt: 40 wedding processional songs grouped by style: classical, church and hymns, instrumental and modern, with notes on how each plays on the aisle, who it suits, and how to time your walk.
key_takeaways: Choose the song for the length of your aisle and the pace of your walk, and favour pieces like Pachelbel's Canon in D that musicians can stretch or shorten around your arrival.

Separate songs for the wedding party and the couple, such as Handel's The Arrival of the Queen of Sheba then Wagner's Bridal Chorus, give the final entrance its own moment and a clear cue for guests to stand.
Classical pieces and hymns suit live players and church settings, while modern songs such as Ed Sheeran's Perfect work well as instrumental arrangements or recordings.
For a destination ceremony, ask the venue and musicians early what a quote covers, who runs the sound and what the back-up is, and get the terms in writing.

faq.q: What do you call the song when the bride walks down the aisle?
faq.a: It is the processional. If the wedding party and the couple walk to different music, the couple's piece is often called the entrance or bridal entrance song. The music for walking out together at the end is the recessional.

faq.q: What is the correct order for a wedding processional?
faq.a: In many ceremonies, the officiant and one partner wait at the front, then parents and grandparents are seated, the wedding party walks in, and the couple, or the person being walked in, enters last. Confirm the order with your officiant.

faq.q: What are some love songs to walk down the aisle to?
faq.a: From the modern list, A Thousand Years, Can't Help Falling in Love, Make You Feel My Love and At Last are slow and romantic. For classical, try Salut d'amour or Clair de lune.

faq.q: What are some modern wedding processional songs?
faq.a: Perfect by Ed Sheeran, Turning Page by Sleeping at Last and I Choose You by Sara Bareilles are good starting points.

faq.q: What songs suit the groom's entrance?
faq.a: A groom or partner who walks in separately often chooses something shorter and more upbeat than the main processional, such as Here Comes the Sun or the Rondeau by Mouret.

faq.q: What are good bridal entrance songs?
faq.a: For a traditional entrance, the Bridal Chorus from Lohengrin or the Prince of Denmark's March. For something gentler, Canon in D, Nuvole Bianche or Clair de lune. For a modern choice, A Thousand Years or At Last.
